designSummary: Umbrella review; no new pooling of primary studies.
sampleSize: No sample size calculation applies. About 26 to 35 reviews are expected from the appraisal record; the synthesis uses one primary review per outcome, so precision is that of the selected review's estimate, reported with its interval and AMSTAR 2 rating.
primaryAnalysis: For each outcome, report the selected review's estimate, interval and certainty; describe the direction and size of estimates from other reviews and explain disagreements by overlap, study design and override policy.
secondaryAnalysis: Corrected covered area; subgroup results by deprivation or language where any review reports them.
missingData: Outcomes not reported by any review are listed as unknown.
software: Spreadsheet citation matrix; R for the corrected covered area.
overfittingGuards: Primary review selection rules fixed before extraction
summary: No new pooling; one appraised review per outcome with overlap reported.
